name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Research & Development Scheme
benefit:
1. The financial assistance shall be extended to eligible organizations as 100% grants in aid.
1. The payments to all beneficiaries/concerned must be made through PFMS only.
1. The disbursement of the assistance will be in two installments:

a)  1st Installment: 75% of the sanctioned amount will be released as an advance.
b)  2nd Installment: 25% of the sanctioned amount will be in the form of rei
_eligibility_text:
**Grants-in-aid can be given to a public body or an institution having a distinct legal entity viz.** 1. Institutions or Organizations setup as Autonomous Organisations, under a specific statute or as a society registered under the Societies Registration Act, 1860, or Indian Trusts Act, 1882. 1. Producer Companies and Section-8 Companies (Company Act, 2013). 1. Non-Government Organizations. 1. Educational and Other Institutions. 1. Urban and Rural Local Self-government Institutions. 1. Export Promotion Councils. 1. Central Cottage Industries Emporium (CCIC). 1. National Crafts Museum & Hastkala Academy, New Delhi. 1. State/Central Govt. Agencies etc.
**The applicant should certify the following in the application form:** 1. No financial assistance has been received from any other source for the same purpose. 1. The provision of the scheme has been fully understood and we take responsibility for the successful completion of the project within the sanctioned project duration. 1. All infrastructure is available with the organization to conduct the programs as per the scheme. 1. There is no duplication of efforts taking Place with existing schemes of the Ministries. 1. No UC is pending in any scheme of the O/o DC (Handicrafts). 1. The organization is registered with Public Finance Management System and will adhere to the Provisions/guidelines of the Department of Expenditure from time to time, in this regard.
